# Beverage-AI Radar

> A curated, source-cited landscape of 557 companies applying artificial intelligence, machine learning and data analytics to the beer, whiskey and wine industries. Maintained by Ankur Napa. Last updated 2026-08-05.

## What this is

Every company is recorded with its own domain plus supporting sources. Entries that
make no AI or machine-learning claim are included and labelled as such rather than
described as AI companies. Scout-discovered entries are marked unverified until a
human confirms them. Treat `verified: false` as provisional.

## Coverage

- Verticals: multiple (221), beer (153), wine (129), whiskey (54)
- Countries: United States (172), unknown (95), United Kingdom (47), Germany (45), France (30), Italy (21), Canada (17), India (17), Australia (15), Belgium (10), Japan (7), Netherlands (7)

## Data

- [All companies (HTML)](https://ankurnapa.github.io/beverage-ai-radar/companies.html): full index, no JavaScript required.
- [data.json](https://ankurnapa.github.io/beverage-ai-radar/data.json): complete machine-readable records.
- [report.md](https://ankurnapa.github.io/beverage-ai-radar/report.md): narrative report.
- [Dashboard](https://ankurnapa.github.io/beverage-ai-radar/): interactive filters, requires JavaScript.
